Zulu: Ngo-2020, abacwaningi baseKenya babonisa ukuthi iNyanza Gulf eLake Victoria, kanye nemithombo yamanzi yasendlini eseduze ingase ibe namakhemikhali ayingozi abizwa ngokuthi ama-microcystins.
Hausa: A cikin shekarar2020, masu bincike na Kenya sun nuna cewa Tekun Nyanza da ke Tafkin Victoria, da maɓuɓɓugar ruwan gida na kusa na iya ƙunsar sinadarai masu cutarwa da ake kira ƙwayoyin halittar gansakuka.
Northern Sotho: Ka 2020, banyakišiši ba naga ya Kenya ba laeditše gore Kalofo ya Nyanza ya Letsha la Victoria, gammogo le methopo ya kgauswi ya meetse ao a šomišwago ka malapeng di ka ba le dikhemikhale tše di lego kotsi tšeo di bitšwago dimaekhrosisthini.
Amharic: በ2020 የኬኒያ ተመራማሪዎች እንዳሳዩት በቪክቶሪያ ሐይቅ ውስጥ የኒያንዛ ባህረ ሰላጤ እና በአጠገቡ ያሉ የቤት ውስጥ የውሃ ምንጮች ማይክሮሲስቲኖች የተሰኙ ጎጂ ኬሚካሎችን ሊይዙ ይችላሉ፡፡

Source: Microcystins are toxins that may cause liver damage in people who use the water for cooking and drinking.
Luganda: Microcystins butwa obuyinza okuleetera ekibumba okukosebwa mu bantu abakozesa amazzi ago okufumba n’okunywa.
Yoruba: Maikurosisitíìnì jẹ́ oró tó lè ba ẹ̀dọ̀ jẹ́ nínú àwọn èèyàn tó bá ń lo omi náà fún mímu tàbí láti se óúnjẹ.
Zulu: Ama-Microcystin awubuthi obungadala ukulimala kwesibindi kubantu abasebenzisa amanzi ukupheka nokuphuza.
Hausa: Ƙwayoyin halittar su ne gubobi waɗanda za su iya haifar da lalacewar hanta a cikin mutanen da ke amfani da ruwa don dafa abinci da sha.
Northern Sotho: Dimaekhrosisthini ke mepholo yeo e ka hlolago kgobatšo ya sebete go batho bao ba šomišago meetse go apea le go nwa.
Amharic: ማይክሮሲስቲኖች ውሃውን ለመጠጥነት እና ምግብ ለማብሰል በሚጠቀሙ ሰዎች ላይ የጉበት ጉዳት ሊያደርሱ የሚችሉ መርዞች ናቸው፡፡

Source: Microcystins are produced by cyanobacteria.
Luganda: Microcystins zizaalibwa cyanobacteria.
Yoruba: Kòkòrò-sàyánò ló maa ń ṣẹ̀dá maikurosisitíìnì.
Zulu: Ama-Microcystin akhiqizwa yi-cyanobacteria.
Hausa: Ana samar da ƙwayoyin halittar gansakuka ta hanyar ƙwayoyin halittar Sino.

Source: A large group of cyanobacteria may appear as a green-blue layer floating on dams or lakes, because these organisms photosynthesise (produce energy using sunlight) in the same way that green plants do.
Luganda: Ekibinja kya cyanobacteria ekinene kiyinza okulabika ng’olububi olwa kiragala owa bbululu oluseeyeeyeza ku ddamu oba ku nnyanja, kubanga ebiwuka ebyo bikola emmere (bikola amaanyi nga bikozesa ekitangaala ky’enjuba) mu ngeri y’emu ng’ebimera ebya langi ya kiragala bwe bikola.
Yoruba: Ọ̀wọ́ àwọn kòkòrò-sàyánò kan tó tóbi lè farahàn gẹ́gẹ́ bí ohun aláwọ̀ ewé àti búlúù tó léfòó lórí àwọn dáàmù àti àwọn omi Adágún, nítorí fotosíntẹ́síìsì (ṣẹ̀dá agbara pẹ̀lú iná òrùn)àwọn ohun ẹlẹ́mìí yìí, gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn ohun ọ̀gbìn ṣe maa ń ṣe.
Zulu: Iqembu elikhulu le-cyanobacteria lingase libonakale njengongqimba oluluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka oluntanta emadamini noma emachibini, ngenxa yokuthi lezi zidalwa eziphilayo ziyi-photosynthesise (zikhiqiza amandla zisebenzisa ukukhanya kwelanga) ngendlela efanayo nezitshalo eziluhlaza.
Hausa: Babban rukuni na bakteriyar gansakuka na iya bayyana a matsayin wani abu koren-ruwan bula da ke ninƙaya a kan madatsun ruwa ko tafkuna, domin waɗannan ƙwayoyin halitta suna cin abinci (suna samar da makamashi ta hanyar amfani da hasken rana) kamar yadda tsirrai suke yi.
Northern Sotho: Sehlopha se segolo sa disianopaktheria se ka tšwelela e le llaga ya botalamorogo-botalaleratadima ye e phaphametšego matamong le matsheng, ka gore ditwatši tše di a fotosithesaesa (di tšweletša enetši ka tšhomišo ya seetša sa letšatši) go swana le ka moo mehlare ye metala e dirago.
Amharic: ትልቅ የሲያኖባክቴሪያ ቡድኖች በግድቦች ወይም በሐይቆች ውስጥ እንደ አረንጓዴ-ሰማያዊ ንብር እየተንሳፈፉ ሊታዩ ይችላሉ፤ ምክንያቱም እነዚህ ፍጥረታት ፎቶሲንተሳይዝ የሚያደርጉት (ጸሃይን በመጠቀም ሃይል የሚያመነጩት) ልክ እንደ አረንጓዴ አትክልቶች ነው፡፡

Source: Parts of Kenya’s Lake Victoria are overgrown with cyanobacteria because of eutrophication, which is when the water becomes too rich in the nutrients that these bacteria thrive on.
Luganda: Ebitundu by’Ennyanja Nalubaale byakuliramu ddala cyanobacteria nga kiva ku eutrophication, ekitegeeza nti amazzi gaba gafunye ebirungo bingi bakitiiriya bya zirya.
Yoruba: Àwọn apa kọ̀ọ̀kan omi Adágún Victoria ti ní kòkòrò-sàyánò uturofikéṣọ̀nù, èyí ni ìgbà tí àwọn aṣaralóore inú omi náà bá pọ̀jù, èyí tó jẹ́ kí àwọn kòkòrò náà gbòòrò si.
Zulu: Izingxenye zeChibi iVictoria laseKenya zigcwele i-cyanobacteria ngenxa ye-eutrophication, okuyilapho amanzi ecebe kakhulu ngemisoco la magciwane achuma ngayo.
Hausa: Sassan Tafkin Victoria na ƙasar Kenya suna cike da bakteriyar gansakuka saboda kayan abinci, wanda shi ne lokacin da ruwa ya yi yawa a cikin abubuwan gina jiki da waɗannan ƙwayoyin ke samu.
Northern Sotho: Ditikologo tša Letsha la Victoria ya Kenya di tletše ka disianopaktheria ka baka la go phuphuma ka menontšha, e lego ge meetse a tlala ka diphepommele tšeo dipaktheria tše di ipshinago ka tšona.

Source: Cyanobacteria produce harmful chemicals called microcystins that damage the liver if ingested.
Luganda: Cynobacteria zizaala ebirungo eby’obulabe ebiyitibwa microcystins ebikosa ekibumba omuntu bw’abisika ne bimuyingira.

Source: Because of this potential danger to communities who rely on the lake, researchers wanted to find out how much microcystins are in the Nyanza Gulf beach of Lake Victoria, as well as nearby household water.
Luganda: N’olw’obusobosi bw’obulabe obwo mu bantu abeesigamya obulamu bwabwe ku nnyanja, abanoonyereza baayagala okuzuula obungi bwa microcystins obuli mu bbiici ya Nyanza Gulf ku Nnyanja Nalubaale wamu n’amazzi agakozesebwa ewaka agali okumpi.

Northern Sotho: Ka baka la kotsi ye e ka hlagelago badudi bao ba botilego letsha, banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go tseba gore ke dimaekhrosisthini tše kae tše di lego lebopong la Kalofo ya Nyanza ya Letsha la Victoria, gammogo le meetseng ao a šomišwago ka malapeng a tikologo.

Source: They also wanted to see which type of microcystin was most common in these water sources.
Luganda: Era baayagala okulaba ekika kya microcystin ekisinga okulabika mu nsulo z’amazzi ezo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún fẹ́ rí irúfẹ́ maikurosisitíìnì tó wọ́pọ̀ jù nínú àwọn orísun omi yìí.

Source: The researchers took samples of water from 6 beaches along the Nyanza Gulf of Lake Victoria, and 127 samples from households along those beaches, between May and October, 2015.

Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà mú àwọn àpẹẹrẹ omi láti etí òkun 6 tó wà ní ara ẹ̀bá-òkun Nyanza ti omi Adágún Victoria, àti àpẹẹrẹ 127 láti àwọn ìdílé tó wà ní tòsí àwọn etí òkun wọ̀nyẹn, láàárin Èbìbí àti Ọ̀wàrà, 2015.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathathe amasampula amanzi emabhishi angu-6 eduze kweNyanza Galfu of Lake Victoria, kanye namasampula angu-127 emizini eseduze nalawo mabhishi, phakathi kukaNhlaba/Meyi noMfumfu/Okthoba, 2015.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ɗauki samfurin ruwa daga rairayin bakin teku guda 6 tare da Tekun Nyanza na Tafkin Victoria, da samfurori guda 127 daga gidaje da ke kusa da waɗannan rairayin bakin teku, tsakanin watan Mayu da Oktoba, na shekarar 2015.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba tšere disampole tša meetse go tšwa mabopong a 6 tša go bapela Kalofo ya Nyanza ya Letsha la Victoria, le disampole tše 127 go tšwa malapeng a go bapela mabopo ao, magareng ga Mei le Oktobere 2015.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በሜይ እና በኦክቶበር 2015 መካከል በቪክቶሪያ ሐይቅ ውስጥ በኒያንዛ ባህረ ሰላጤ አካባቢ ከ6 የውሃ ዳርቻዎች እና በእነዚሁ የውሃ ዳርቻዎች አካባቢ ካሉ ቤቶች 127 ናሙናዎችን ወስደዋል፡፡

Source: They checked if microcystins were present, and which types.
Luganda: Baakebera okulaba nga microcystins zaalimu, ate n’okumanya ebika byennyini ebyalimu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣàyẹ̀wò bóyá maikurosisitíìnì wà níbẹ̀, àti pe irú èwo.
Zulu: Babheka ukuthi ngabe ama-microcystin akhona, nokuthi yiziphi izinhlobo.
Hausa: Sun bincika ko akwai ƙwayoyin halittar gansakuka, kuma wane nau'i ne.
Northern Sotho: Ba lekotše ge e ba go be go na le dimaekhrosisthini, le gore e be e la tša mehuta efe.
Amharic: ማይክሮሲስቲኖች መኖራቸውን እና ካሉም ምን አይነት እንደሆኑ ፈትሸዋል ፡፡

Source: They said 80% of all the water samples, both beach and households, contained microcystins, and that the amount of toxins were higher than what is normally deemed safe.
Luganda: Baagamba nti ebitundu 80% ebya sampolo z’amazzi, okuva ku bbiici ne mu maka, byalimu microcystis, era nti obungi bw’obutwa bwali waggulu nnyo okusinga ku obwo obugambibwa obutaba na bulabe.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní 80% gbogbo àpẹẹrẹ omi náà, ti etí òkun àti àwọn ìdílé, ló ní àwọn maikurosisitíìnì, àti pé iye àwọn oró náà pọ̀ ju ohun tí wọ́n maa ń lérò pé kò léwu ní ọ̀pọ̀ ìgbà lọ.
Zulu: Bathe u-80% wawo wonke amasampula amanzi, olwandle kanye nemizi, aqukethe ama-microcystin, nokuthi inani lobuthi lingaphezulu kwalokho okuvame ukubhekwa njengokuphephile.
Hausa: Sun ce kashi 80% na duk samfuran ruwa, na rairayin bakin teku da gidaje, sun ƙunshi ƙwayoyin halittar gansakuka, kuma adadin gubobi ya fi abin da aka saba gani lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore 80% ya disampole ka moka tša ka meetseng, tša mabopong le tša ka malapeng, di be di na le dimaekhrosisthini, le gore kelo ya mepholo e be e feta yeo e bego e bonwa e bolokegile.
Amharic: ሁለቱም የውሃ ዳርቻ እና የቤት ውስጥ 80% ያህል የውሃ ናሙናዎች ማይክሮሲስቲኖችን ይዘው ነበር፤ የመርዞች ይዘታቸውም በተለምዶ ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ ነው ተብሎ ከሚታመነው መጠን ከፍ ያለ ነበር፡፡

Source: They also found different strains of microcystins.
Luganda: Mu ngeri y’emu era baazuula obusirikitu bwa microsystins obw’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún sàwárí oríṣiríṣi ẹ̀yà àwọn maikurosisitíìnì.
Zulu: Baphinde bathola izinhlobo ezahlukene ze-microcystins.
Hausa: Sun kuma sami nau'o’in ƙwayoyin halittar gansakuka daban-daban.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše le mehuta ye e fapafapanego ya dimaekhrosisthini.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ የተለያዩ የማይክሮሲስቲኖች አይነቶችን አግኝተዋል፡፡

Source: A strain called MC-RR was the most common, followed by MC-YR and MC-LR.
Luganda: Akasirikitu akayitibwa MC-RR ke kaali kasinga okulabika, ne kaddirirwa MC-YR ne MC-LR.
Yoruba: Ẹ̀yà kan tí wọ́n pè ní MC-RR ló wọ́pọ̀ jù, MC-YR àti MC-LR ló tẹ̀le.
Zulu: I-strain ebizwa nge-MC-RR ibivame kakhulu, ilandelwa yi-MC-YR ne-MC-LR.
Hausa: Wani nau'i mai suna MC-RR shi ne ya fi kowanne, sai kuma MC-YR da MC-LR biye.
Northern Sotho: Mohuta wo o bitšwago MC-RR e bile o montši kudu, wa latelwa ke MC-YR le MC-LR.

Source: Interestingly, the researchers noticed that there were more microcystins in May and October, and said this was because of the high rainfall during those months.
Luganda: Ekyewuunyisa, abanoonyereza baakiraba nti waaliwo microcystins mu Gwokutaano n’Ogwekkumi, era ne bagamba nti ekyo kyaliwo olw’enkuba eyali ennyingi mu myezi egyo.
Yoruba: Ohun tó tún jẹ́ kàyéfì nípa ẹ̀ ni pé, àwọn aṣèwádìí sàkíyèsí pé maikurosisitíìnì pọ̀ si nínú oṣù Èbìbí àti Ọ̀wàrà, wọ́n sì sọ pé èyí jẹ́ nítorí òjò rírọ̀ tó pọ̀ ní àwọn oṣù náà.
Zulu: Kuyathakasisa ukuthi abacwaningi baqaphela ukuthi kunama-microcystin amaningi ngoMeyi no-Okthoba, futhi bathi lokhu kwakungenxa yemvula enkulu ngalezo zinyanga.
Hausa: Abin sha'awa shi ne, masu binciken sun lura cewa an sami ƙarin ƙwayoyin halittar gansakuka a watan Mayu da Oktoba, kuma sun ce hakan ya faru ne saboda yawan ruwan sama a waɗannan watanni.
Northern Sotho: Sa go kgahliša, banyakišiši ba lemogile gore go bile le dimaekhrosisthini tše ntši ka Mei le Oktobere, gomme ba laetša gore se se bakilwe ke dipula tše kgolo dikgweding tšeo.
Amharic: በሚገርም ሁኔታ፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ በሜይ እና በኦክቶበር ብዙ ማይክሮሲስቲኖች እንደነበሩ ያስተዋሉ ሲሆን ይህም የሆነው በእነዚህ ወራት በነበረው ከፍተኛ ዝናብ ምክንያት ነው፡፡

Source: The results from their study agrees with previous studies that also found MC-RR is the most common, and that toxins found in these beaches are above the limit that is considered safe.
Luganda: Ebyava mu kunoonyereza kwabwe bikwatagana n’ebyo eby’okunoonyereza okwasooka okwazuula nti MC-RR ke kasinga okulabika, era nti obutwa obusangibwa ku bbiici ezo busukka ku kigero ekisembayo okutwalibwa ng’ekitalina bulabe.
Yoruba: Àwọn èsì ìwádìí wọn lọ pẹ̀lú ìwádìí ti tẹ́lẹ̀ tó ṣàwárí pé MC-RR ló wọ́pọ̀ jù, àti pé àwọn oró tí wọ́n rí ní àwọn etí òkun yí pọ̀ ju ohun tí wọ́n maa ń lérò pé kò léwu lọ.
Zulu: Imiphumela yocwaningo lwabo ivumelana nezifundo zangaphambilini eziphinde zathola ukuthi i-MC-RR ivame kakhulu, nokuthi ubuthi obutholakala kulawa mabhishi bungaphezu komkhawulo obhekwa njengophephile.
Hausa: Sakamakon binciken nasu ya yarda da binciken da aka yi a baya wanda kuma ya gano MC-RR shi ne mafi yawa, kuma cewa gubobin da aka samu a cikin waɗannan rairayin bakin teku sun wuce yawan da ba za a kalle su a zaman lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo go tšwa dinyakišišo tša bona di dumelelana le dinyakišišo tša peleng tšeo le tšona di hweditšego gore MC-RR e be e tletše kudu ka bontši, le gore mepholo ye e hweditšwego ka mabopong ao e be e feta kelo yeo e bonwago e le yeo e bolokegilego.
Amharic: የዚህ ጥናት ግኝቶች ከዚህ በፊት ከተደረጉ ጥናቶች ጋር የሚስማሙ ሲሆን MC-RR በጣም የተለመደው አይነት እንደሆነም አግኝተዋል፤ እንዲሁም በእነዚህ የውሃ ዳርቻዎች የሚገኙት መርዞች በተለምዶ ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ ነው ተብሎ ከሚታሰበው ገደብ ከፍ ያሉ ናቸው፡፡

Source: But, they added more detail about exactly how much and what type of microcystins are found.
Luganda: Wabula, baayongerako okunnyonnyola ku bungi n’ekika kya microcystins ekyazuulibwa.
Yoruba: Ṣùgbọ́n, wọ́n fi kún àlàyé wọn nípa iye pàtó àti irúfẹ́ maikurosisitíìnì tí wọ́n rí.
Zulu: Kodwa, bangeze imininingwane eyengeziwe mayelana nokuthi ingakanani nokuthi hlobo luni lwama-microcystin atholakalayo.
Hausa: Amma, sun ƙara bayani dalla-dalla game da ainihin yawan da kuma irin nau'in ƙwayoyin halittar gansakuka da aka samu.
Northern Sotho: Eupša, ba tlaleleditše ka tshedimošo ye nngwe mabapi le gore ke dimaekhrosisthini tše kae le tša mohuta ofe tše di hweditšwego.
Amharic: ግን ምን ያህል እና ምን አይነት ማይክሮሲስቲኖች እንደተገኙ ተጨማሪ ዝርዝሮችን ጨምረዋል፡፡

Source: The researchers advised that current water treatments are not adequate to remove the toxins, and they suggested that the government must keep the communities who rely on this water aware about the potential danger to their health.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baawa amagezi okulongoosa amazzi okukolebwa mu kiseera kino tekumala kuggyamu butwa, era ne bateesa nti gavumenti zirina okukuuma abantu abeesigama ku mazzi ago nga babamanyisa obuzibu obuyinza okutuuka ku bulamu bwabwe.
Yoruba: Wọ́n gbàá lámọ̀ràn pé àwọn ìtọ́jú omi tó ń lọ lọ́wọ́ ò tó láti yọ àwọn oró náà, wọ́n sì dábàá pé kí ìjọba sọ fún àwọn agbègbè tó gbẹ́kẹ̀lé omi yìí ìjàm̀bá tó lè ṣẹlẹ̀ sí ìlera wọn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baluleke ngokuthi imithi yokwelapha ekhona njengamanje akwanele ukususa ubuthi, baphakamisa ukuthi uhulumeni kumele aqwashise imiphakathi ethembele kula manzi ngengozi engaba yingozi empilweni yayo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ba da shawarar cewa maganin da ake amfani da shi na ruwa a halin yanzu bai wadatar don kawar da gubobin ba, kuma sun ba da shawarar cewa dole ne gwamnati ta sa al'ummomin da suka dogara da wannan ruwa su san haɗarin da zai iya haifarwa ga lafiyarsu.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba eleditše gore go hlwekišwa gabjale ga meetse ga se gwa lekanela go tloša mepholo, gomme ba šišinya gore mmušo o swanetše go lemoša badudi bao ba botilego meetse a ka ga kotsi ye e ka ba hlagelago maphelong.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በአሁኑ ጊዜ የሚተገበሩት የውሃ ህክምናዎች መርዞችን ለማስወገድ በቂ እንዳልሆኑ ይመክራሉ፤ እንዲሁም በእዚህ ውሃ ላይ የሚተማመኑ ማህበረሰቦች ሊያጋጥሟቸው ስለሚችሉ አደጋዎች መንግስት ማሳሰብ እንዳለበት ይመክራሉ፡፡

Source: The authors of this paper are from Kenya and their study was done at Lake Victoria, Kenya.
